TASK: Rewrite `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.size-charts.tsx` to use React Polaris components instead of `<s-*>` web components.

IMPORTANT: The app already has PolarisAppProvider set up in app.tsx. All React Polaris components are available.

MIGRATION RULES — Replace every `<s-*>` component:
- `<s-page heading="X">` → `<Page title="X" backAction={{ onAction: () => navigate("/app") }}>`
- `<s-section heading="X">` → containers using `<BlockStack>` or `<Layout.Section>`
- `<s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">` → `<Card>`
- `<s-stack direction="block" gap="base">` → `<BlockStack gap="400">`
- `<s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">` → `<InlineStack gap="400">`
- `<s-heading>` → `<Text as="h2" variant="headingMd" fontWeight="bold">`
- `<s-text>` → `<Text as="p" variant="bodyMd">`
- `<s-text color="subdued">` → `<Text as="p" variant="bodyMd" tone="subdued">`
- `<s-badge tone="X">Y</s-badge>` → `<Badge tone="X">Y</Badge>`
- `<s-button variant="primary">` → `<Button variant="primary">`
- `<s-button variant="tertiary">` → `<Button>` (default) or `<Button variant="plain">`
- `<s-button tone="critical">` → `<Button tone="critical">`
- `<s-button href="/app/X">` → `<Button url="/app/X">`
- `<s-banner tone="X" heading="Y">` → `<Banner tone="X" title="Y">`
- `<s-divider />` → `<Divider />`
- `<s-link href="X">Y</s-link>` → `<Button variant="plain" url="X">Y</Button>`
- `<s-search-field>` → `<TextField prefix={<Icon source={SearchIcon} />} placeholder="Search..." value={x} onChange={setX} autoComplete="off" />`
- `<s-select>` + `<s-option>` → `<Select options={[{label:"X",value:"y"}]} value={v} onChange={setV} />`
- `<s-text-field>` → `<TextField label="X" value={v} onChange={setV} />`
- `<s-text-area>` → `<TextField label="X" value={v} onChange={setV} multiline={8} />`
- `<s-button-group>` → `<ButtonGroup>` or `<ButtonGroup variant="segmented">`
- `<s-button slot="primary-action">` → Page `primaryAction` prop
- `<s-button slot="secondary-action">` → Page `secondaryActions` prop
- `<s-unordered-list>` + `<s-list-item>` → `<List>` + `<List.Item>`

For the template picker modal, use `<Modal>` from Polaris:
```typescript
import { Modal } from "@shopify/polaris";
<Modal open={showTemplates} onClose={() => setShowTemplates(false)} title="Create a size chart" large>
  <Modal.Section>
    {/* template grid content */}
  </Modal.Section>
</Modal>
```

For template cards grid: `<InlineGrid columns={{ xs: 1, sm: 2, md: 3 }} gap="400">`

For the import panel, use a Modal too or a Card that expands.

IMPORTANT: `<s-select>` with `onChange` web component pattern `(e: Event) => fn((e.target as HTMLSelectElement).value)` becomes simply `onChange={fn}` with React Polaris `<Select>`.
Similarly `<s-text-field onChange>` becomes `<TextField onChange={fn}>` where fn receives the value string directly.

IMPORTS needed:
```typescript
import { useNavigate } from "react-router";
import {
  Page, Layout, Card, BlockStack, InlineStack, Text, Badge, Button,
  ButtonGroup, Banner, Box, Divider, InlineGrid, ProgressBar, Modal,
  TextField, Select, Icon,
} from "@shopify/polaris";
import { SearchIcon } from "@shopify/polaris-icons";
```

KEEP: All loader/action logic, types, constants, helpers unchanged. Only rewrite the JSX.

Read the current file first, understand its structure, then rewrite. The file should have ZERO `<s-` elements when done. Verify by searching for remaining `<s-` tags.
